verdict.rationale: Raygun ships a built-in 'AI Resolution' chat assistant that provides AI-powered root-cause suggestions and lets users collaboratively chat about fixing errors, which is a real in-product AI assistant a user can delegate diagnostic tasks to. However, it's scoped narrowly to crash/error resolution rather than general task delegation across the product, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of its effectiveness. Missing for 10: broader-scope assistant beyond error resolution, independent verification of quality/accuracy, more detail on what tasks can be delegated.
